summary: DevRelay V0.4 has approved Requirements, ProjectOverview, Architecture, WorkBreakdown, and WorkDependency baselines plus released RequirementsGathering, ArchitectureDesign, WorkBreakdown, WorkDependencyAnalysis, and TraceabilityGraph capabilities. V0.5 freezes the full V1 lifecycle and adds dynamic human-readable run reporting before the remaining modules are built one by one.
domainConstraints: Generic Core owns exact artifact loading, deterministic routing, adapter resolution, checkpointing, validation, Gate progression, and ready-frontier derivation.
Modules own provider-neutral contracts while adapters own bounded native-tool capabilities.
Candidate and approved authority remain distinct and Gate promotion is exact and explicit.
Effectful model output is checkpointed and replayed rather than assumed bit-reproducible.
Adapters never receive or mutate TraceabilityGraph and cannot author graph operations.
Operational reporting observes workflow facts but cannot become routing, evidence, or approval authority.
SpecialistAssignment cannot select readiness, schedule work, execute, modify the DAG, or bind a concrete provider, model, human, or process.
Optimization follows a complete measured end-to-end run.
conventions: Use exact immutable module and adapter versions.
Use SHA-256-bound artifacts and raw-byte verification at runtime boundaries.
Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and Ajv validation.
Use lowercase kebab-case ports, operations, relationships, and machine outcomes.
Store forward graph relationships only and derive reverse traversal at query time.
Label adapter bindings contract-defined, fixture-conformant, live-conformant, or release-ready.
Represent missing observations with explicit captured, not-reported, or not-applicable dispositions.
Prove generic behavior through positive, negative, replay, drift, non-authority, and Core special-case tests.
